The lower sub-tiles at (600..664, 438..464) are blue/dark green ramps. (4) No text: none is visible anywhere. (5) Red diagonal flecks: I cannot confirm this visually. They read as dim corner tint in a blocky gradient, not as distinct red flecks in a diagonal arrangement. I raise no objection because the seed formula passed and I cannot name a contradicting pixel. Suggested pixel test for the operator: in (600..664, 400..464), count pixels with R > G and R > B, and test whether they lie along a diagonal.

atomic_adjudication.adjudication: The independent formula, not the shared renderer, checks every mosaic and background pixel. Red is XOR(x,y,20), with 64 maximum-red pixels at x XOR y = 43, a diagonal XOR band. Expect does not require red-dominant flecks. Opus raised no contradicting pixel, and its suggested R>G,R>B test adds an unstated predicate. Under U16 the independent exact formula settles the dim red variation; vision separately confirmed geometry, black surround, ramps and no text.
